name: solvency_attestation
description: N=16 proof of reserves: prove sum of 16 Poseidon-committed balances meets a public threshold, without revealing individual balances
useCases: Prove assets exceed liabilities without publishing the books

commitments.description: Per-account Poseidon([balance, salt]) commitments published in advance

threshold.description: Required minimum sum of balances (constrained to 64 bits)
